title: Stochastically evolving ellipsoids with symmetries
summary: We prove that there is a universal constant $c > 0$ such that, along an infinite sequence of dimensions $N$, there are lattice sphere packings in $\mathbb{R}^N$ of density at least $c N^2 \log\log N \, 2^{-N}$, improving the previous best bound due to Klartag by a $\log\log N$ factor. The proof follows Klartag's stochastic ellipsoid evolution process, subject to the cyclotomic symmetries introduced by Venkatesh.
